title: What Honeymoon Planning Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of honeymoon planning: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Honeymoons: book 4-6 months out, budget $3,000-$7,000 for a week, and pick the trip that fits you - not the brochure. Shoulder season = better prices, fewer crowds.

Why it matters: Book flights/hotels 4-6 months ahead Shoulder season saves 20-40%

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Honeymoon Planning
summary: Start honeymoon planning this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Agree on trip style (relax, adventure, city)
2. Set the budget with a buffer
3. Pick 2-3 destinations; compare seasons
4. Book flights, then hotels
5. Buy travel insurance

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: Agree on trip style (relax, adventure, city)
Set the budget with a buffer

title: Common Honeymoon Planning Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with honeymoon planning — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Over-scheduling every day → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Skipping travel insurance → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- No passport check (6-month validity rule) → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Planning during peak hurricane/monsoon season → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

title: Honeymoon Planning Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common honeymoon planning questions.
body:
Q: How far ahead?
A: 4-6 months for international; 2-3 for domestic.

Q: All-inclusive?
A: Great for budgeting; less adventure.

Q: How long?
A: 7-10 days is the sweet spot.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
